title: Filtered coherent coslices and strong cofinality under cocone formation
statement:
Use the universes, infinite regular cardinals, small simplicial sets and filtered quasicategories of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], and coherent functors, cocones, mapping spaces and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For a diagram $p:K\to\mathcal D$, the coherent cocone quasicategory $\mathcal D_{p/}$ has objects $(d,\alpha:p\to\Delta_K d)$, morphisms given by arrows between the vertices and coherent commuting triangles, and all higher compatibilities; $\Delta_K d$ is the constant diagram. For a functor $f:\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$ between filtered quasicategories, weakly cofinal means that each $e\in\mathcal E$ admits an arrow $e\to f(d)$ for some $d\in\mathcal D$. For an infinite regular $\kappa$, $f$ is $\kappa$-cofinal if, for each $\kappa$-small weakly contractible simplicial set $L$ and diagram $r:L\to\mathcal D$, the functor $\mathcal D_{r/}\to\mathcal E_{fr/}$ is weakly cofinal. Weakly contractible means that inverting all arrows gives a contractible space. 

Let $\kappa,\tau$ be infinite regular cardinals, with no ordering assumed. If $\mathcal D$ is $\tau$-filtered and $K$ is $\tau$-small, then $\mathcal D_{p/}$ is $\tau$-filtered. If $\mathcal D$ admits all $\tau$-small $\kappa$-filtered colimits, the vertex projection $\mathcal D_{p/}\to\mathcal D$ creates these colimits: a colimit of the vertex diagram extends to a colimit cocone in $\mathcal D_{p/}$, and a cocone there is colimiting exactly when its vertex cocone is. If $f:\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$ preserves these colimits, the induced functor $f_p:\mathcal D_{p/}\to\mathcal E_{fp/}$ preserves them whenever both ambient categories admit them.

If $f:\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$ is $\kappa$-cofinal between $\tau$-filtered quasicategories and $p:K\to\mathcal D$ has $K$ $\tau$-small, then $f_p$ is $\kappa$-cofinal. If instead $q:K\to\mathcal E$ has $K$ both $\kappa$-small and $\tau$-small, then the relative cocone category
$$\mathcal D_{q/}:=\mathcal D\times^h_{\mathcal E}\mathcal E_{q/}$$
is $\tau$-filtered and its functor to $\mathcal E_{q/}$ is $\kappa$-cofinal. Here the homotopy pullback has objects $(d,c,e:f(d)\simeq\operatorname{vertex}(c))$ with coherent pairs of arrows and all higher compatibilities; it is the category of cones from $q$ to an image $f(d)$.

source.place: HTT (April 9, 2017), Lemmas 5.3.1.21, 5.4.5.11, 5.4.5.14 and 5.4.6.4; coherent cocone and relative-cocone versions. Vertex creation for filtered shapes follows from the weakly contractible shape case of Proposition 4.3.1.12, equivalently the cocone universal property. No matching Stacks tag.
